    Representation-finiteness without closed words #

    If a string algebra has no closed word with all cyclic adjacent pairs allowed, then it is representation-finite (isRepFinite_of_not_hasClosed): an indecomposable module is a single string piece with one-dimensional blocks, and its string has no repeated letter, since a repeated letter cuts out an allowed closed word. Band pieces are excluded because a band is an allowed closed word.
